summary: Navitas Semiconductor filed an 8-K/A solely to correct the signing date of a Stock Purchase Agreement to September 18, 2026. Under the agreement, Magnachip will issue and sell Navitas 1,461,988 shares at $3.42 per share for $5.0 million aggregate, closing on or about September 24, 2026. Magnachip must file a Form S-3 resale registration statement within 30 days and seek effectiveness within 60-90 days. This is a small, privately negotiated equity investment, not a special situation. Watch registration effectiveness and any stake-related governance rights, but no deal arbitrage angle exists.
